pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d4 into the d4-knight; plan 4 called ...h6 a challenge to a pin that is not one. Fixed; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 cxd4 10.Nxd4 h6
pages.notes: Plan 4 put the c8-bishop on b6/d6 and suggested ...Qh4 against the g3 fianchetto; rewrote around ...Be6/...Bg4 and ...Re8; plan 2 wrote Ne4 as a White move. British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 cxd4 10.Nxd4 h6 11.Be3
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the blockading knight Nd4-b3-d2 away from d4; plan 2 pushed ...d5-d4 into it. Fixed; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 cxd4 10.Nxd4 h6 11.Be3 Re8 12.Qb3
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...d5-d4 into the d4-knight; made conditional; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 cxd4 10.Nxd4 h6 11.Be3 Re8 12.Rc1
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed d5-d4 into the d4-knight; made conditional; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 cxd4 10.Nxd4 h6 11.Be3 Re8 12.Rc1 Bf8
pages.notes: Plan 2 proposed ...Bf8-g7 with a pawn on g7 and ...d5-d4 into the knight; rewrote around the defending f8-bishop and Nxc6 bxc6. British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.dxc5 Bxc5 10.Bg5 Be6 11.Bxf6
pages.notes: Overview and plans assumed ...gxf6 and a pawn on h6 (none); the main recapture is ...Qxf6, then Nxd5 Qxb2. Rewrote the overview and both plans.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.dxc5 Bxc5 10.Bg5 d4 11.Bxf6 Qxf6 12.Nd5
pages.notes: Overview said Nd5 attacks the d4-pawn (it attacks the f6-queen); plan 3 had Ne2-f4 (no knight on e2) and c3 (no white c-pawn); plan 4 had ...c4 with no black c-pawn. Rewrote; reviewer caught a spelling slip in the first draft, fixed and re-accepted.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.dxc5 Bxc5 10.Bg5 d4 11.Bxf6: Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a meaningless f1-e3 route; rewrote around Nb3 hitting c5; plan 2 listed ...Re8 already played. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Tarrasch Defense, Stoltz Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight Nd2-f1-e3 with a rook on f1; plan 2 pushed ...d4 into White's d4-pawn. Rewrote around dxc5 and isolated or hanging pawns; British spelling.
